ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with an approximate 40/60 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches occupy the distal halves of both lobes. The left lobe white region contains fine black speckling, while the right lobe white region is intersected by several prominent dark linear streaks and a concentrated dark cluster near the upper trailing edge. The peduncle attachment and central notch area are entirely low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55-60 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:3 within its local bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme irregular serration across the entire horizontal boundary; high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the mid-to-outer trailing edges of both lobes, isolated against the lighter sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve along the trailing edge, transitioning into sharply tapered, upwardly-curved tips on both the left and right extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are visible on the extreme terminal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the white field of the right lobe, including three parallel diagonal lines and one intersecting horizontal mark.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/excision is present on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, distinct from the surrounding uniform serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique dark pigmentation pattern resembling a 'wishbone' or 'Y' shape is visible within the white patch of the right lobe.
